drug_class: Hepatitis C virus NS3/4A protease inhibitor

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer reduces simeprevir concentrations significantly, decreasing antiviral efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; discontinue at least 2 weeks before simeprevir initiation

avoid_supplements.name: Garlic supplements (high-dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may reduce simeprevir plasma concentrations and therapeutic effect
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose garlic supplements; monitor for reduced efficacy if used

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 inhibition may increase simeprevir levels; effect typically mild with extract formulations
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously and monitor for adverse effects; standardized extracts preferred over whole grapefruit

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases simeprevir bioavailability and plasma concentrations, elevating toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Avoid consumption during simeprevir therapy; patient counseling essential

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: Fat-rich meals may increase simeprevir absorption; current formulations show improved bioavailability regardless
caution_foods.action: May take with or without food per current formulations; verify with patient's specific product labeling

monitoring_notes: Simeprevir is substrate of CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein; assess for significant drug/supplement interactions affecting metabolism. Maintain HCV viral load monitoring during therapy to confirm adequate simeprevir exposure and therapeutic response.
